title: Chat bubble lifecycle (made, updated, faded, destroyed)
oneLine: Per-speaker speech bubble: made on text, re-measured on change, faded at 4.5 s, destroyed when quiet.

title: Emote pop over the head
oneLine: Emoji Text per player popping, settling, rising and fading over EMOTE_POP_MS, destroyed the frame it ends.

title: A ground loot pile's life on the phone
oneLine: Pile landing, lying, rare call, last-call pulse, expiry and disposal; the renderer splices S.groundLoot itself.
topConcern: Renderer removes monster piles at 30 s (phone clock vs worker ts); worker keeps and grants them until 60 s, groundLoot.js says 60 s/forever.

title: Ground decals: footprints and hit splatter fading by age
oneLine: Footprint and splatter decals fading by age against TTLs that stateCleanup filters by; pools hide.

title: Snapped arrow pieces
oneLine: Queue-fed arrow-snap pieces flying, landing flat, resting, fading; capped and wiped on zone change.

title: Marks on props: slashes, stuck arrows and burn marks
oneLine: Prop marks with per-kind TTLs and caps, broken-object exit, zone wipe; your planted arrows reaped by tick.
topConcern: Per-prop overlay containers are only hidden when empty, never destroyed inside a zone; the Wheel is one zone all session.

title: A gather node's drawn life (alive, broken, revived, see-through, promoted)
oneLine: Node draw follows worker alive flag, one-shot break, orphan dispose, tree fade ease, layer promotion while worked.

title: One-shot effect queues (bursts, blasts, shockwaves, smoke, pops)
oneLine: Game/wire queues drained into playing lists, stepped by age, destroyed at end; frost frames freed mid-play handled.

title: A vein breaking (crack, split, settle, fade)
oneLine: Ore break once-flags cracked/popped/faded on the break's age, with a lateness bound for stalled frames.

title: The fire goblin's burning ground (inert, lit, guttering, out)
oneLine: Fire patches restamped at receipt with remaining life and arm time: inert, lit, guttering, spliced.

title: Whirlwind wind-up ring, catch marks and vortex
oneLine: Wind-up ring for you and peers, client copy of the worker's catch scan into S._whirlCatch, then the vortex.
topConcern: Catch measured at drawn positions while the worker scans its own; an edge monster can be painted caught and missed.

title: The smith at work (anvil, fire and sparks)
oneLine: Smithing FX container shown while S._smithing lasts, strike-frame edge for sparks and the hammer sound.

title: Elemental status looks on you and on peers
oneLine: Thirteen *Until status stamps on you or a peer drawn as looks; peer pre-filter repeats the active-status test.
topConcern: Peer pre-filter omits _wobbleUntil/_frozenUntil, so a peer's post-daze wobble is never drawn; clearElemStatuses has no caller at all.

title: Your fire-lighting figure
oneLine: S._firemaking's 700 ms light drives a once-through strip at its spot, then the tick lights the campfire.

title: Other players' harvest stand-ins and their pool
oneLine: Per-peer stand-in entry (code, start, drawn-last-frame, side) driven by relayed o._ex; reaped when the peer leaves.
topConcern: Peer-left reap never destroys ent.gear legs/shirt/chest sprites; three hidden sprites per departed gatherer stay in gestureLayer all session.

title: Other players' sword swing, bow shot and block stand-ins
oneLine: Peer attack poses from relayed swing/shot stamps; entityRenderer hides the body, this pass draws the stand-in.
topConcern: Swings and shots have no readiness handshake: body hidden on the stamp, stand-in skipped if the bake returns null, peer invisible 300-360 ms.

title: Your sword and bow stand-ins and the flags traded with entityRenderer
oneLine: Your swing, shot and block pose drawn from entityRenderer's flags; publishes _bowArtReady and the bow grip back.
topConcern: _bowArtReady answers for the last shot's facing one frame late while a block can face anywhere; all facings preload today.

title: Gear strip and dressed-shirt textures (loading, ready, failed, dropped)
oneLine: Per-key gear strip and dressed-shirt texture states with load guards, LRU, farm drop and rebuild release.
topConcern: A strip whose one fetch fails is cached as [] forever; that armour or shirt vanishes from attack and gathering poses all session.

title: The farmer's moves, made on the farm and let go of on leaving
oneLine: Farm strips, tools and garments made per generation behind the farm's loading screen, re-baked, freed on exit.
topConcern: Leave and re-enter while tools load: the stale generation's Assets.unload destroys the texture the new generation just cut frames from.

title: The harvest's visuals and sounds, read off S._extraction
oneLine: Waiting/ready harvest phases read in eight places: bar, label, chopper, cook, clink, splash, grease, SFX loops.
topConcern: SFX loops stop only when this pass runs each frame; an earlier unwrapped pass throwing leaves sizzle or water playing. Linger code is dead.

title: Fish flying into the bag (catch flights)
oneLine: Catch-flight arc animation still stepped each frame; nothing has pushed S._catchFlights since v2.3.1429.

title: The Wheel's dressing, made on first need and let go by an empty list
oneLine: Wheel managers (fish, auras, doors, signposts, race flags, trap marks) made on demand, drained with an empty list.

title: Photographing the world's effects for the stat scene
oneLine: Captures borrow stand-in sprites and window probes between frames and restore them in finally.

title: Owning a baked picture (owned, GPU only, waiting for first draw, let go)
oneLine: Each bake registered so re-bakes, farm exit or rebuild release it after pointing sprites at Texture.EMPTY.
